risky_wrong_mapping_fix_notes: Removed Junior Croatian Olympiad mappings incorrectly matched to senior Croatian Olympiad contests.

non_ac_mismatch_fix_notes: Corrected IOI 2013 Cave/Robots mapping by actual task title.
Corrected ICPC Yokohama 2022 mapping using solved.ac titles rather than Petrozavodsk mirror labels.
Removed Singapore NOI, CCPC Weihai/Open Cup Weihai, POI year-confusion, and BOJ 13504 false mappings.
